main.remarks: This interface defines the operational contracts of DataItems.

method.name: CheckDataHash
method.summary: Verify the secure hash for this item. This does not check digital signatures.
method.returns: True if the current data matches the stored hash; otherwise, false.

method.name: DecryptData
method.summary: Decrypt content using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.param: Composite security context used for decryption and assertion validation.
method.returns: True when decryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: EncryptData
method.summary: Encrypt content using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.param: Composite security context used for recipient selection, envelope creation, and assertion generation.
method.returns: True when encryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: ProtectData
method.summary: Protect the current active item state using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.remarks: Encrypts clear content or validates already-protected content.
method.param: Composite security context used for protection and validation.
method.returns: True when the item ends in a valid protected state; otherwise false.

method.name: GetContentStream
method.summary: Opens a Stream from the FILE path. The Object's Content field is ignored.
method.returns: Content Stream.

method.name: GetContentStreamed
method.summary: Get ContentStreamed.
method.returns: True if the Object's Content is Streamed from FILE. Use GetContentStream instead of GetContent.

method.name: GetDataContent
method.summary: Get `DataItem` content using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext` when protection or validation work is required.
method.param: Optional composite security context used when content must be decrypted or validated.
method.returns: Current `DataItem` content when available.

method.name: GetDataEncrypted
method.summary: Get DataEncrypt.
method.returns: True if data is encrypted.

method.name: GetDataProtectionInfo
method.summary: Get current `DataProtectionInfo` summary metadata.
method.returns: Current protection summary information.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize the current object to an array of bytes .
method.returns: A Byte array representing the serialized object.

method.name: GetDataType
method.summary: Get DataType.
method.returns: DataType.

method.name: IsMetadataOnly
method.summary: Determine whether the current item exposes metadata only and no active content binding.
method.remarks: Returns true only when the item is not content-streamed, does not expose a FILE-backed binding, and does not retain item-type-specific in-memory content.
method.returns: True when the current item state is metadata-only; otherwise false.

method.name: SetContentStreamed
method.summary: Switch the streamed-content mode using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext` when security work is required.
method.param: True to enable streamed content mode.
Optional composite security context used when content must be reprotected during the mode change.
method.returns: True when the mode change succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: SetDataType
method.summary: Set DataType.
method.returns: Returns true if DataType was set successfully.

method.name: SignData
method.summary: Create or replace the active current-state assertion for the specified field using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.param: Composite security context used to author the assertion.
method.returns: Identifier or key for the active assertion when signing succeeds.

method.name: UnProtectData
method.summary: UnProtect the current item state using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.remarks: Decrypts protected content when needed and always validates the resulting active item state.
method.param: Composite security context used for decryption and validation.
method.returns: True when the item ends in a valid unprotected state; otherwise false.

method.name: ValidateData
method.summary: Validate the active current-state assertion for this item using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.param: Composite security context used to resolve signer identity and validate the current active state.
method.returns: True when the current asserted state validates successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: ToFile
method.summary: Write to file.
method.returns: Returns true if Object successfully written to file.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Serialize.
method.returns: Serialized Object.

method.name: VerifyData
method.summary: Verify the active current-state assertion for the specified field using the supplied `DataItemSecurityContext`.
method.param: Composite security context used to resolve signer identity and verify the assertion.
method.returns: True when verification succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: WipeData
method.summary: Overwrite content with random data followed by zeros.
method.remarks: Does not securely erase data on all physical media types and configurations.
method.param: Optional composite security context used when wiping interacts with protected content state.
method.returns: True when the wipe operation succeeds; otherwise false.
